relevance.rationale: Defines the FRT RTT presentation of O_q(G) and U_q(g), quantum determinant, and quantum trace tr_q(X) = Tr(q^{2 rho} X) matching Woronowicz modular Haar trace.

keyResults.statement: Constructs O_q(SU(2)) via RTT relations and identifies central L-operator quantum traces with modular q^{2 rho}-weighted matrix traces.
keyResults.useForFolio: Provides the quantum-trace and quantum-determinant framework audited in Family 1 and Family 3 of the 2026-11-28 untapped algebraic invariants audit.

proposedActions.rationale: Evaluated in computations/probes/untapped_algebraic_invariants_proton_probe.py across O_q(SU(2)) Haar/modular weights and Hecke exterior invariants.
